title: Herbal Chicken Dumplings
description: A soothing and savory dish featuring tender chicken and dumplings infused with the subtle flavors of herbs.
instructions: Combine herbs, garlic, and chicken in a bowl.
Mix well to ensure the chicken is evenly coated.
Prepare dumpling wrappers according to package instructions.
Place a tablespoon of the chicken mixture onto the center of each wrapper.
Fold the wrapper into a triangle and press the edges together to seal.
In a large pot, bring 2 cups of water to a boil.
Gently add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 10-12 minutes or until cooked through.
Serve hot with a side of steamed vegetables.
